ex.t: He held office for eight years.
The government must be accountable to the people.
He won a clear mandate in the election.
He belongs to the ruling party.
The government is pushing pension reform.
The separation of powers is basic to democracy.

title.ko: 정치와 통치: pass legislation · hold office · be accountable to · a mandate
title.en: politics and governance: pass legislation, hold office, be accountable to, a mandate

explain.ko: 정치와 통치에 관한 영어는 제도와 과정을 설명하는 어휘가 중심입니다. 입법(pass legislation, introduce a bill), 행정(hold office, implement policy), 책임(be accountable to), 선거(win a mandate, turnout, majority), 개혁(push reform) 같은 연어를 익히세요. 뉴스에서는 수동태와 인용 구조(is expected to, has been criticised for)가 자주 쓰이며, 정치적 중립을 지키기 위해 헤징도 자주 사용됩니다.
explain.en: English on politics and governance centres on vocabulary for institutions and processes. Learn collocations for legislation (pass legislation, introduce a bill), executive action (hold office, implement policy), accountability (be accountable to), elections (win a mandate, turnout, majority) and reform (push reform). News uses passives and reporting structures (is expected to, has been criticised for), and hedging helps keep neutrality.

lines.t: To whom must the government be accountable?
Did you see the news? Parliament passed the new bill.
They criticised the lack of consultation.

trans.ko:

B: 야당은 어떻게 반응했어?
A: 충분한 협의가 없었다고 비판했어.

lines.t: In a democracy, powers are separated and check each other. The legislature makes laws, the executive carries them out and the judiciary judges. A government receives a mandate through elections but must be accountable to the people.

trans.ko: 민주주의에서는 권력이 분립되어 서로 견제합니다. 입법부는 법을 만들고 행정부는 집행하며 사법부는 판단합니다. 정부는 선거를 통해 위임을 받지만 국민에게 책임을 져야 합니다.

lines.t: What was turnout in this election?
Lower than at the last election.
It may be a sign of growing distrust in politics.

items.passage:
EDITORIAL
Transparent government
If it isn't disclosed how government decisions are made, citizens cannot trust them. Transparency prevents corruption and clarifies responsibility. The government should disclose policy-making processes as far as possible.

trans.ko:
사설
투명한 정부
정부의 결정이 어떻게 이루어졌는지 공개되지 않으면 시민은 신뢰할 수 없다. 투명성은 부패를 막고 책임을 분명히 한다. 정부는 정책 결정 과정을 가능한 한 공개해야 한다.

items.passage: The editorial argues that government transparency raises trust. Transparency increases corruption. The editorial demands disclosure of policy-making processes.

prompt.ko: 정치 제도나 최근 뉴스를 배경·쟁점·반응·평가 순으로 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences on a political system or recent news: background, issue, reaction, assessment.

task.model: Parliament has passed a pension reform bill. The government said it pursued reform on the mandate given by the people. The opposition criticised the reform for being carried out without sufficient consultation. For reform to succeed, transparent communication and social consensus are needed.

model_trans.ko: 의회는 연금 개혁 법안을 통과시켰습니다. 정부는 국민이 위임한 권한으로 개혁을 추진했다고 밝혔습니다. 야당은 개혁이 충분한 협의 없이 이루어졌다고 비판했습니다. 개혁이 성공하려면 투명한 소통과 사회적 합의가 필요합니다.
model_trans.en: Parliament has passed a pension reform bill. The government said it pursued reform on the mandate given by the people. The opposition criticised the reform for being carried out without sufficient consultation. For reform to succeed, transparent communication and social consensus are needed.
